hook.en: Now he wants to tell stories.

objective: Meta episode: The Traveler turns toward storytelling itself — YouTube, characters, his own journey as content. A new portal opens that looks disconnected from everything before it, but by now both The Traveler and the audience recognize the pattern: it will probably connect to the map too.

scenes.description: A new, different kind of portal opens
scenes.visuals: Beside Moon's many known portals, a new one flickers open — dim, unlabeled, unlike the others in texture (softer light, more like a camera lens than a server rack)
scenes.copy: Ya no quería construir solo software. Quería contar historias.
assets_needed: new unlabeled portal design (softer, camera-like light)

scenes.visuals: Quick flashes through the new portal: characters forming, a camera-eye motif, storyboards, YouTube-shaped light panels
scenes.copy: Personajes. YouTube. Tecnología. Natación. Naturaleza. Viajes. IA. Su propio recorrido, convertido en contenido.

scenes.visuals: A label of light forms above the new portal: OPSLY CREATOR STUDIO
The Traveler and NØVA looking at the new, still-dim portal together
scenes.copy: Otro mundo. Otra curiosidad. Algo que parecía desconectado de todo lo anterior.

scenes.visuals: Very brief, subtle: the portal's shape echoes the exact framing of this very episode — a soft self-aware wink to the audience, not overplayed
scenes.copy: Pero por ahora, ya conocían el patrón. Probablemente, también se conecta.

metadata.call_to_action: Otra curiosidad. Probablemente también se conecta.

captions.es: El mapa incluso se dibuja a sí mismo contándose.
captions.en: The map even draws itself by telling itself.

metadata.thumbnail_concept: A new, still-dim portal opening beside all the others on Moon's map, labeled only with a question mark, The Traveler and NØVA looking at it together

notes: Act XI of the Origin Saga — see ../../canon/ORIGIN-SAGA.md. This episode is meta: it is, itself, part of what it depicts (the Opsly Creator Studio content system that produced this very series).
Theme: recursion — the pattern of 'another world that looks disconnected but probably connects' repeats one more time, this time as the show itself.
Real event / fictionalization boundary: see ../../canon/TIMELINE.md row 11. This episode IS the real event — keep the fictionalization light, almost a wink to the audience.
Placed just before The Message/The Map (12-13) so the season's final act returns fully to the core mystery thread.
